plugins.name: waybill
plugins.description: A leg route with pluggable carriers: one command names the leg a change is on, the command that runs it next, and the model that command wants. Reads every leg's stamp off repository reality — a branch, a bay, a file, an exit code — so there is no state file to keep in sync and a leg done by hand counts the same as one done through the tool.
